description.text: The other DP5 expansion, released on 14 March 2008 alongside Cry from the Mysterious with entirely different cards. It is led by the legendary Regigigas, joined by Regirock, Regice and Registeel, Deoxys and Mewtwo, and its wrapper is themed on Snowpoint Temple, where Regigigas appears in Pokémon Diamond and Pearl. Azelf, Magnezone and Porygon-Z appear as LV.X. In English most of its cards came out in Legends Awakened in August 2008.
